description: This entity manages system permissions, user roles, and access control configurations within the application. It allows checking user access to routes, retrieving entity-specific permissions, and managing system-wide role definitions.

endpoints.name: GetSystemPermissionConfiguration
endpoints.description: Retrieves the entire system permission configuration, including all roles and their capabilities, for frontend initialization.
example_uses: Get the full permission structure of the system.
Retrieve all defined roles and their associated permissions.
Initialize the frontend with the complete system permission configuration.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch the comprehensive, system-wide permission configuration, typically at application startup or for administrative overview.

endpoints.name: CheckUserRoutePermission
endpoints.description: Checks if the current authenticated user has permission to access a specific route or page, returning access status and specific permissions for that route.

route.description: The route/URL path to check permissions for (e.g., '/partnerships/contacts/123')

example_uses: Check if the current user can access the '/admin/users' page.
Determine if a user has access to a specific application path.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to dynamically verify if the current user is authorized to view or interact with a particular application route or page.

endpoints.name: GetEntityPermissionDetails
endpoints.description: Retrieves complete permission details for a specific entity, including all possible operations and role requirements for that entity.
example_uses: Get all permissions related to the 'Contact' entity.
Show what operations are allowed on the 'Partner' entity.
Retrieve the detailed permission configuration for the 'Interaction' entity.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to understand the granular permissions and role requirements associated with a specific data entity within the system.

endpoints.name: GetCurrentUserRoles
endpoints.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user's assigned roles and basic permission information.
example_uses: Find out what roles the currently logged-in user has.
Display the roles assigned to me.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to quickly fetch the roles and basic permissions of the user currently making the request.

endpoints.name: GetUserRolesByUserId
endpoints.description: Retrieves roles and basic information for a specific user identified by their ID. This operation typically requires administrative access.

userId.description: The ID of the user to retrieve role information for

example_uses: Check the permissions of a specific user by their ID.
Retrieve the role assignments for user 'abc-def-ghi'.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint (with appropriate administrative privileges) to look up the roles and basic information for any user in the system by their unique ID.

endpoints.name: GetAvailableSystemRoles
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all available system roles along with their descriptions.
example_uses: List all roles that can be assigned in the system.
Get a catalog of all predefined system roles.
Display the names and descriptions of all available roles.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get a comprehensive list of all roles defined within the system, useful for role management interfaces or understanding system capabilities.
